title: In situ macrophage reprogramming via micropatch engineering for safe and effective antitumor adoptive cell therapy.
snippet: Adoptive cell therapy with macrophages holds great promise for treating solid tumors, but its clinical impact has been limited. The problem is twofold: the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment quickly silences the anti-tumor activity of transferred cells, and systemic activation strategies often provoke off-target toxicity.
